name: iterStep_invariant
statement:
theorem iterStep_invariant {S : Type} (step : StepFn S) (P : S → Prop)
    (hInv : IsInvariant step P) :
    ∀ n x y, P x → iterStep step n x = some y → P y
  | 0, _, _, hx, hIter => by
      simp [iterStep] at hIter
      cases hIter
      exact hx
  | n + 1, x, y, hx, hIter => by
      simp only [iterStep] at hIter
      split at hIter
      · contradiction
      · rename_i x' hStep
        have hx' : P x'

name: iterStep_strict_lyapunov_drift
statement:
theorem iterStep_strict_lyapunov_drift {S : Type} (step : StepFn S) (P : S → Prop)
    (E : S → Nat) (d : Nat)
    (hInv : IsInvariant step P)
    (hDrift : ∀ x x', P x → step x = some x' → E x + d ≤ E x') :
    ∀ n x y, P x → iterStep step n x = some y → E x + n * d ≤ E y
  | 0, _, _, _, hIter => by
      simp [iterStep] at hIter
      cases hIter
      omega
  | n + 1, x, y, hx, hIter => by
      simp only [iterStep] at hIter
      split at hIter
      · contradiction
      · rename_i x' hStep
        have hx' : P x'

name: lexProgress_trans
iterStep_lex_lyapunov_drift
statement:
theorem iterStep_lex_lyapunov_drift {S : Type} (step : StepFn S) (P : S → Prop)
    (E rank : S → Nat)
    (hInv : IsInvariant step P)
    (hLex : ∀ x x', P x → step x = some x' → LexProgress E rank x x') :
    ∀ k x y, P x → iterStep step (k + 1) x = some y → LexProgress E rank x y
  | 0, x, y, hx, hIter => by
      simp only [iterStep] at hIter
      split at hIter
      · contradiction
      · rename_i x' hStep
        simp [iterStep] at hIter
        cases hIter

  | k + 1, x, y, hx, hIter => by
      simp only [iterStep] at hIter
      split at hIter
      · contradiction
      · rename_i x' hStep
        have hx' : P x'

theorem iterStep_invariant {S : Type} (step : StepFn S) (P : S → Prop)
    (hInv : IsInvariant step P) :
    ∀ n : Nat, ∀ x y : S, P x → iterStep step n x = some y → P y
  | 0, _, y, hx, hIter => by
      simp [iterStep] at hIter
      subst hIter
      exact hx
  | n + 1, x, y, hx, hIter => by
      simp only [iterStep] at hIter
      split at hIter
      · contradiction
      · rename_i x' hStep
        exact iterStep_invariant step P hInv n x' y (hInv x x' hx hStep) hIter

/-- Master Inductive Safety Meta-Theorem:
    If `P` is forward-invariant and every state satisfying `P` has a valid successor
    (`step x ≠ none`), then every initial state in `P` is unconditionally non-halting,
    producing a witness `y` in `P` at every step `n`. -/
theorem iterStep_exists_of_safe_invariant {S : Type} (step : StepFn S) (P : S → Prop)
    (hInv : IsInvariant step P)
    (hSafe : ∀ x : S, P x → step x ≠ none) :
    ∀ n : Nat, ∀ x : S, P x → ∃ y : S, iterStep step n x = some y ∧ P y
  | 0, x, hx => ⟨x, rfl, hx⟩
  | n + 1, x, hx => by
      cases hStep : step x with
      | none => exact False.elim (hSafe x hx hStep)
      | some x' =>
          have hx' : P x'

statement:
theorem walkParity_gauge_telescope (eps0 : Nat → Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (vs : List Nat) (u : Nat),
      walkParity (gaugeShiftEdge eps0 f) u vs =
        xor (walkParity eps0 u vs) (xor (f (lastVertex u vs)) (f u))
  | [], u => by
      simp [walkParity, lastVertex]
  | v :: vs, u => by
      simp only [walkParity, lastVertex]
      rw [walkParity_gauge_telescope eps0 f vs v]
      unfold gaugeShiftEdge
      cases (eps0 u v) <;> cases (walkParity eps0 v vs) <;>
        cases (f u) <;> cases (f v) <;> cases (f (lastVertex v vs)) <;> rfl

/-- **Closed-Loop Coboundary Gauge Invariance**:
    Along ANY closed walk returning to `u0` (`lastVertex u0 vs = u0`), the total `F_2`
    holonomy is strictly invariant under all local gauge transformations `f`. -/
theorem coboundary_closed_walk_invariant
    (eps0 : Nat → Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Bool) (u0 : Nat) (vs : List Nat)
    (hClosed : lastVertex u0 vs = u0) :
    walkParity (gaugeShiftEdge eps0 f) u0 vs = walkParity eps0 u0 vs
